start.speaker: kaj7
start.text: I do not sleep. I sit here and I listen to the signal, and lately I listen to you all sleep instead. It is a better signal. I wanted to tell you that in a room with a door, because the Envoy would call it a fault.

choices.text: It is not a fault. It is the best thing about you.
Whatever you are, you are ours. Nobody restores you.
Keep listening. Wake me if the signal changes.
